info.title: Constellation Control Plane API
info.description: Phase 1 control-plane endpoints. Astronomer integration surfaces /api/v1/security/* alongside the standalone /api/v1/* routes.

runtimeAgent.description: Runtime-agent service-principal token (cra_ prefix), not a user JWT.

browserSession.name: __Host-constellation-session
browserSession.description: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict access cookie. Browser mutations additionally require X-Constellation-Client: browser and a validated same-origin or explicitly allowed Origin. Explicit Authorization takes precedence.

last_match_timestamp.description: Unix seconds; zero when never matched.

action.description: Only deny is treated as deny; all other values default to allow.

PortableNetworkRule.description: An authored rule or learned-rule override. An import row with a missing or blank endpoint is reported as a per-row error, not a request-level error.

ports.description: Omitted when empty on export; blank values default to any on import.

action.description: Only deny is treated as deny on import; other values default to allow.

priority.description: Non-positive values default to 1000 on import.

cfg_type.description: Advisory on import; the target cluster's learned-flow history determines the stored value.

NetworkRuleImportBundle.description: The importer requires the constellation/v1 NetworkRuleBundle envelope and at least one rule. Rules may fail individually while the request still returns 200.

protocol.description: L4 protocol; defaults to TCP when omitted or empty.

port.description: Port 0 means any port for the protocol.

policies.description: Affected workload names, not runtime policy IDs.

sensor_id.description: Optional. When omitted, the server uses the stable all-current-rules sensor ID for the selected kind.

data.description: Source table row for finding/threat; string message for an in-stream error.

duration_s.description: Defaults to 30 seconds; clamped to 5–300 seconds.

token.description: Bearer JWT returned only to non-browser login clients; never returned in browser or refresh responses.

message.description: Safe validation message without submitted values.

verified.description: Cryptographic verification result, never inferred from uploaded signer metadata. Format, integrity, counts and caller organization are validated even when false.

ResponseRuleDef.description: E1 declarative response rule: binds a runtime event_type + condition set to an ordered set of actions. Evaluated server-side and pulled by the runtime-agent via the :sync bundle.

priority.description: Lower number is evaluated first (higher precedence).

AuthServer.description: B4 DB-backed auth provider (IdP). One of LDAP/SAML/OIDC. The config object's meaningful fields depend on type. Provider secrets (config.bind_password, config.sp_key_pem, config.client_secret) are returned redacted on read, and a redaction-marker echo on update preserves the stored secret.

name.description: Unique provider name within the org.

auth_order.description: Lower value is preferred when multiple providers of the same type are enabled.

config.description: Provider-specific configuration. LDAP: url, bind_dn, bind_password, base_dn, user_filter, group_attribute, email_attribute. SAML: idp_metadata_xml, entity_id, acs_url, sp_cert_pem, sp_key_pem, group_attribute, email_attribute. OIDC: issuer_url, client_id, client_secret, redirect_url, scopes.

role_mapping.description: Maps IdP-supplied group/attribute values (lower-cased) to Constellation role names, with an optional default role.

SystemConfig.description: Runtime-mutable system configuration. Secret-bearing fields (ca_bundle_pem, and any credentials embedded in egress_proxy.https_proxy) are returned redacted on GET.

https_proxy.description: Outbound HTTP(S) proxy URL. Embedded credentials are redacted on read.

tls_verify.description: Whether shared outbound clients verify upstream TLS certificates (default true).

ca_bundle_pem.description: Additional trusted CA bundle (PEM). Returned redacted when set.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard JSON error envelope returned by API handlers.

source.description: Redacted diagnostics; never raw omitted credentials.

target_cluster_id.description: Resolved target cluster when cluster-scoped; absent for organization-wide previews.

target_group_id.description: Empty when the target group is created by this import.

get.description: Lists the calling org's configured LDAP/SAML/OIDC identity providers. Each entry carries its type, name, enabled flag, auth_order, provider config, and group->role mapping. Provider secrets (LDAP bind password, SAML SP private key, OIDC client secret) are redacted. Requires the manage_auth_servers verb.

post.description: Creates a new LDAP/SAML/OIDC identity provider for the calling org. The provider-specific config (including secrets) is validated by type. On success the live verifier set is hot-reloaded so the new provider takes effect without a restart. Requires the manage_auth_servers verb.

400.description: Invalid body or provider config (unknown type, missing required fields).

409.description: A provider with that name already exists in the org.

delete.description: Deletes the provider and hot-reloads the live verifier set so it stops authenticating without a restart. Requires the manage_auth_servers verb.

put.description: Replaces the provider's mutable fields (name, enabled, auth_order, config, role mapping). The type is immutable. A secret echoed back as the redaction marker (or left empty) preserves the stored secret rather than wiping it. On success the live verifier set is hot-reloaded without a restart. Requires the manage_auth_servers verb.

404.description: No provider with that id in the org.

409.description: A provider with that name already exists in the org.

post.summary: Preview saved provider group-to-role and scope resolution
post.description: Requires manage_auth_servers. Resolves up to 50 already-extracted LDAP group CNs, SAML group attribute values, or OIDC groups-claim values against the caller organization's saved provider mapping and scoped grants. Uses the same mapping resolver as sign-in but does not contact an IdP, verify an assertion or token, authenticate a user, or persist an assignment. Response includes only counts and mapped role/scope grants; supplied groups and provider secrets are not echoed. Disabled providers can also be previewed. Unknown request fields (such as credentials or tokens) are rejected.

200.description: Redacted saved-mapping result. Grants are mapping results, not proof of a successful sign-in.

400.description: Invalid group values or unsupported input fields.

404.description: Provider not found in caller organization.

409.description: A saved scoped mapping references a cluster outside the caller organization.

post.summary: Test a saved identity provider configuration
post.description: Requires manage_auth_servers. Tests only the caller organization's stored provider: LDAPS TLS and optional service bind, local SAML metadata parsing (not a live IdP fetch), or HTTPS OIDC discovery. This bounded probe intentionally rejects private, loopback, link-local, and other non-public LDAP/OIDC targets; private enterprise and air-gapped IdPs are not supported by this test endpoint yet. Outbound connections pin a vetted resolved address, disallow redirects and proxies, and have a short timeout. No credentials, metadata, or remote error detail is returned.

404.description: Provider not found in the caller's organization.

post.description: Browser clients send X-Constellation-Client: browser with a validated Origin and receive secure HttpOnly cookies, not a JSON token. Non-browser clients receive a bearer token. Access tokens expire within 15 minutes. Responses are never cacheable.

403.description: Browser origin or CSRF header rejected.

post.description: Revokes all user sessions and refresh families and expires both browser cookies. Cookie-authenticated requests require browser CSRF headers.

Requires the secure HttpOnly refresh cookie, X-Constellation-Client: browser and a validated Origin. Atomically consumes the old refresh secret and issues new cookies without extending the absolute session lifetime. Reuse revokes the entire session family, including issued access tokens. No credentials are returned in JSON.

200.description: Cookies rotated; response is not cacheable.

401.description: Refresh session missing, expired, revoked or reused; cookies cleared.

403.description: Browser origin or CSRF header rejected.

post.description: Validates the signed SAML response. Browser requests additionally require a single-use five-minute SP-login cookie matching POST RelayState; unsolicited IdP-initiated browser ACS is rejected. The cookie is HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None for the cross-site IdP POST. Pending requests require serving-replica login affinity. Non-browser bearer responses remain supported; form bodies are limited to one MiB.

400.description: Invalid SAML form; submitted assertion data is not echoed.

403.description: Missing, expired, mismatched or consumed browser login binding; restart SP login.

413.description: SAML form body exceeds one MiB.

post.summary: Validate SAML assertion and browser login binding

post.description: Requires manage-org. Restores only into the authenticated organization; identity tables additionally require manage-users. All writes commit atomically. Deployment policy controls signature trust; query parameters cannot bypass it. Invalid format, table integrity, row counts or unresolved cluster scope are always rejected.

200.description: Validated manifest and cryptographic verification status

get.description: Streams the calling org's configuration as a YAML document suitable for storing in git and re-applying via the import endpoint. Includes users, custom roles, role bindings, org settings, policies, groups, vuln profiles, response rules, receivers, registries, WAF/DLP rules, custom frameworks, and an API-token inventory. Secrets never leave in cleartext: user password hashes and API-token hashes are blanked, registry credentials are emitted still AES-GCM-sealed, and the registry KEK is stripped. Requires the manage_org verb.

200.description: The org configuration document rendered as YAML.

500.description: The configuration could not be assembled or serialized.

post.description: Applies an uploaded YAML configuration document to the calling org. The merge-vs-replace selector is REQUIRED via the mode query parameter: mode=merge upserts rows by natural key and leaves not-present rows untouched; mode=replace additionally deletes the org's rows whose natural key is absent from the document (scoped to the org, so it can never affect another tenant). API tokens are metadata-only and never written. Requires the manage_org verb.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Apply semantics: 'merge' (upsert by natural key) or 'replace' (upsert and delete-not-present, scoped to the org).

200.description: Per-table apply statistics (new / updated / skipped row counts).

400.description: Missing/invalid mode parameter, unparseable YAML, or an apply error.

delete.summary: Proxy a delete request to a federated joint (admin)
delete.description: Cross-cluster admin reverse-proxy (D3). Forwards the request to the joint resolved from its federation membership endpoint, stripping the inbound Authorization/Cookie and hop-by-hop headers and attaching the master's own federation credential (a short-lived D1 sync ticket, plus a CA-issued client certificate when D2 mTLS is enabled). The target host is taken ONLY from the registered endpoint, so it can never be pointed at an arbitrary URL. RBAC: GET is open to any reader but a non-admin is limited to a read-only path allowlist; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require the manage_org verb (federation admin).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Federated cluster id (cluster_id of a registered fed member). Must resolve to a known membership row; an unregistered id returns 404 (SSRF guard — the target host is never caller-supplied).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The joint API sub-path to forward, captured by the route wildcard and prefixed with /api/v1 on the joint (e.g. 'findings', 'scan-results/{digest}'). Scheme and host always come from the registered endpoint, never from this value.

200.description: The joint's response, streamed back verbatim (status, headers minus hop-by-hop, and body).

403.description: Caller lacks the required verb (non-admins may only GET allowlisted read paths; mutating verbs require manage_org), or the target cluster is revoked.

404.description: No federation membership row for {id} in the caller's org, or the member has no registered endpoint.

502.description: The joint endpoint is unreachable or returned an invalid response.

post.summary: Exchange a federation join token for a per-cluster sync secret
post.description: Anonymous exchange endpoint (D1/D2). A joining cluster presents a join token (a signed, master-minted token or the pre-shared fixed GitOps token) plus its cluster id/name and receives a per-cluster signed sync ticket it then presents on every /federation/sync poll. Only the sha256 of the ticket is persisted by the master (like api_tokens). Authenticated by the join token itself, so it carries no bearer security. When per-joint mTLS (D2) is enabled the response also includes a per-joint client certificate, its private key (shown once), and the master CA: the joint presents the client cert on every /sync poll and the master verifies it against the CA, so a leaked bearer ticket alone — without the matching client key — is rejected.

join_token.description: Signed master-minted join token, or the pre-shared fixed token

client_cert.description: D2: PEM per-joint client certificate (CN = cluster_id), present only when mTLS is enabled

client_key.description: D2: PEM private key for the client certificate (shown once), present only when mTLS is enabled

ca_cert.description: D2: PEM master federation CA the joint pins on its /sync connection, present only when mTLS is enabled

500.description: Credential persistence or certificate issuance failed

post.summary: Mint a short-lived signed federation join token
post.description: Master-only (D1). Mints an RS256-signed, short-lived join token an operator hands to a joining cluster to bootstrap trust. Requires the org to be in the federation master state and the manage-org verb. The optional ttl_seconds shortens (never extends) the configured ceiling.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional shorter lifetime; capped at the configured ceiling

409.description: Org is not a federation master

get.description: Per-cluster federation credential auth (D1), NOT a user JWT. The joint presents its signed per-cluster sync ticket as the bearer; the master validates the signature and the fed_credentials row (live, not revoked, epoch current) before returning rule revisions strictly greater than ?since=. A generic read-findings principal can no longer reach this endpoint.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return revisions strictly greater than this revision number

parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: Legacy joint identity; ignored when the credential supplies it

200.description: Rule revisions since the requested revision

401.description: Missing or invalid federation sync ticket

get.summary: Stream all saved migration import history
get.description: Streams every saved migration import for the authenticated organization as newline-delimited JSON in a repeatable-read snapshot, ordered by created_at descending then id descending. Output is metadata-only: raw previews, rollback bundles, unsupported reasons/source and error text are never exported. Consumers must require the final complete record and matching count; a missing completion record means the stream failed or was interrupted and must not be treated as a complete export. No row limit is applied; rows are streamed rather than buffered into a single response.

200.description: NDJSON import records followed by a required completion record

schema.description: Each line is a JSON object. Import lines have type=import, id, source, status, created_at, unsupported_count, and optional target_cluster_id/applied_at/rolled_back_at. The final line has type=complete and count equal to the number of import lines.

post.description: Applies reviewed equivalents from a saved preview atomically with rollback snapshots. Registry metadata requires registry-management permission, imports no credentials, uses manual cadence and disables automatic database-update rescans. Unsupported source semantics remain explicit and are never represented as imported.

post.summary: Preview reviewed migration equivalents and explicit unsupported objects

get.summary: Export response rules as portable YAML
get.description: Exports only org-wide rules when cluster_id is omitted, or only rules belonging to the named cluster when present. Requires an org-wide manage_runtime_rules grant; cluster-scoped grants do not authorize this query-parameter route. The file contains no tenant, cluster, or database identifiers and can be imported into another matching scope. Existing receiver IDs are resolved to portable names for notify, ticket, or webhook; quarantine may carry a true/false isolate value. Unknown params fail closed with 422 and no partial YAML is emitted because arbitrary params may contain credentials.

parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: Owned cluster whose cluster-specific rules to export; omit for org-wide rules.

application/yaml.example:
api_version: constellation.io/v1
kind: ResponseRules
scope: global
rules:
  - name: notify-high
    description: Notify on high-severity events
    enabled: true
    priority: 10
    event_type: runtime
    conditions:
      - type: level
        value: high
    actions:
      - kind: notify
        target: security-team
    workload_match: {}

403.description: Caller lacks manage_runtime_rules for this scope.

404.description: Cluster is not owned by this organization.

422.description: A rule contains unsupported action params or an unavailable receiver. No YAML is returned.

post.summary: Import response rules from portable YAML
post.description: Atomically imports up to 100 validated rules into the selected scope. A durable attempt audit precedes writes, and a completion audit commits in the same transaction as the rules. The document must use api_version constellation.io/v1, kind ResponseRules, and scope global or cluster matching the endpoint. Existing names in another scope always conflict. Within the selected scope on_conflict defaults to error; skip retains a rule and replace updates its definition and priority. Each rule may override on_conflict. Action params may reference an existing target-org receiver by name for notify, ticket, or webhook, or carry a true/false isolate value for quarantine; receiver IDs and unknown params are rejected, not silently redacted. YAML aliases, anchors, unknown fields, multiple documents, and documents over 1 MiB are rejected. Requires an org-wide manage_runtime_rules grant; cluster-scoped grants do not authorize this query-parameter route.

parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: Owned target cluster; omit to import org-wide rules.

parameters.name: on_conflict
parameters.description: Default policy for names already present in this scope. Rules can override it with their own on_conflict field.

application/yaml.example:
api_version: constellation.io/v1
kind: ResponseRules
scope: global
rules:
  - name: notify-high
    description: Notify on high-severity events
    enabled: true
    priority: 10
    event_type: runtime
    conditions:
      - type: level
        value: high
    actions:
      - kind: notify
        target: security-team
    workload_match: {}
    on_conflict: replace

ports.description: Empty or omitted ports mean all ports.

201.description: Edge saved; optional expansion result is returned when requested.

post.description: Requires manage_policies for cluster_id through an organization-wide or matching cluster grant. Upserts by cluster, from_group, and to_group. Durable audit attempts precede mutation. With expand=true, the edge and its runtime policies commit or roll back together. Changing mode or ports on an already expanded edge retracts its owned policies and expands replacement policies in the same transaction, even when expand is omitted. Ambiguous policy ownership returns 409 without applying the change.

204.description: Edge deleted with any fully edge-owned expanded runtime policies retracted.

delete.description: Requires manage_policies for the edge's cluster through an organization-wide or matching cluster grant. The edge ID is resolved within the caller's organization; a missing or foreign edge returns 404. A durable audit attempt precedes mutation. Edge deletion and retraction of fully edge-owned policies commit or roll back together; ambiguous policy ownership returns 409.

post.description: Requires manage_policies for the edge's cluster through an organization-wide or matching cluster grant. The edge ID is resolved within the caller's organization; a missing or foreign edge returns 404. A durable audit attempt precedes mutation. All expansion policy writes commit or roll back together; ambiguous policy ownership returns 409.

get.description: Returns a merged, time-ordered timeline across DPI threats, runtime events, network violations, and audit rows. Supports NeuVector-style category filtering through source, severity, time-window, text, namespace, workload, and reference filters.

parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: Optional cluster scope. Audit rows are org-level and omitted when this is set.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated timeline sources: dpi_threat,runtime_event,network_violation,audit.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Comma-separated normalized severities: critical,high,medium,low,info.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower RFC3339 time bound. Defaults to seven days before now.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper RFC3339 time bound. Defaults to now plus one minute.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text match against normalized title, id, workload, namespace, and reference fields.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace substring filter.

parameters.name: workload
parameters.description: Workload substring filter.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Source reference substring filter, such as threat id, verdict, policy, or audit target kind.

get.description: Returns a redacted JSON diagnostics bundle for support handoff. The bundle includes runtime system configuration with secrets masked, system health, component inventory, scanner queue/capacity state, policy summaries, recent audit metadata, and a SHA-256 integrity hash over the redacted sections. When CONSTELLATION_SUPPORT_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY_FILE points to a valid Ed25519 PKCS#8 PEM key, integrity includes a detached Ed25519 signature and public-key fingerprint; callers must pin the expected public key or key_id out of band. Requires the manage_system_config verb and writes a support.bundle.download audit event.
Returns a bounded, cursor-paginated history scoped to the authenticated organization. Requires manage_system_config.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Defaults to 50; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

post.description: Persists a queued support-bundle job for the authenticated organization. A database-backed worker generates and stores only the redacted bundle. Requires manage_system_config and writes an audit event.

get.description: Returns status and audit linkage for an organization-scoped job; never includes bundle payload or raw failures. Requires manage_system_config.

get.description: Returns the org's live runtime system configuration (egress proxy, TLS verify + CA bundle, syslog/SIEM target, scanner autoscale bounds) with secrets redacted. Requires the manage_system_config verb.

200.description: The current configuration (secrets redacted) and its revision.

source.description: Effective source for the returned config: system_config when persisted, default when no row exists.

updated_at.description: Last persisted update timestamp for the system_config row.

updated_by.description: User ID that last updated the system_config row, when recorded.

patch.description: Applies a partial, validated update to the org's system configuration and bumps the revision so in-process consumers hot-reload without a restart. Only the keys present in the body are changed; unknown keys are rejected. A ca_bundle_pem or credentialed egress proxy echoed back as the redaction marker is left unchanged. Requires the manage_system_config verb.

200.description: The merged configuration (secrets redacted) and its new revision.

400.description: Invalid patch body or a field that failed validation; rejected values are never echoed.

409.description: The configuration was changed concurrently; retry with the latest revision.
